regionalPlacement.method: Spherical anchor distance minus bounding radii of both full local road windows. Each radius includes maximum vertex distance, longest meridian/parallel edge-length upper bound and50m margin. Triangle inequality covers every interpolated point at every independent current/history phase. Complete trips may overlap; current/history motion stays in its assigned window.
